title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
summary: Weave Robotics has launched Isaac 1, a $7,999 consumer home robot with planned deliveries in Fall 2026, marking a significant entry into the personal robotics market at a price point designed for mainstream adoption.
problem_solved: Brings advanced home robotics capabilities to consumers at a relatively accessible price point for household assistance tasks.
why_valuable: Offers a commercially viable home robot with significant AI capabilities at $7,999, making personal robotics more accessible than previous enterprise-only solutions.
